source_interpretation.title: Shared precursor preparation, distinct solvent conditions
source_interpretation.text: Every final solvent route retains the stated 6 g Ti(SO4)2, 0.2 M solution, 3 M ammonia to pH 7.5, 20 h aging, filtrate conductivity strictly below 100 μs/cm, 125 mL selected solvent, 0.5 h ultrasound, 2.5 mL 30 wt% H2O2 in an ice bath, 78°C 4 h reflux and 120°C 15 h solvothermal treatment. Unknown volumes, ramps and pressure remain unknown.

source_interpretation.title: Before-treatment evidence is not a final-product result
source_interpretation.text: Figures 1–3 panels a, b show water/ethanol precursors before solvothermal treatment: yellow aqueous colloid or straw-yellow ethanol precipitate, mainly amorphous. Panels c–i are after treatment. Precursor FTIR 900 cm−1 signal is assigned to the aqueous peroxo group; absence/persistence wording does not quantify an exact residual concentration.

source_interpretation.title: Labeled table mapping retains the contradictory prose order
source_interpretation.text: Table 1 explicitly assigns each TEM/XRD/area/zeta/activity value to TW, TWE4, TWE1, TWE0.25, TE. The preceding Figure 2 e–i order and prose Scherrer list conflict. The table assignment remains explicit alongside that conflict; the narrative 9.0 nm endpoint does not replace Table 1 9.7 nm.

source_interpretation.title: Lengths, widths, particles and crystallites remain separate
source_interpretation.text: TW is described as rods about 80×7 nm; TE as rectangles about 26×14 nm. Table 1 DTEM 80.6 and 26.1 nm are source diameter metrics, whereas 13.4 and 11.8 nm are Scherrer crystallite estimates. HRTEM 3.4/4.8 Å source assignments are retained literally and do not establish a measured unit-cell model.

source_interpretation.title: Poor solvent controls are not omitted or promoted to successes
source_interpretation.text: Pure n-propanol and n-butanol yield poorly crystalline aggregated material with amorphous floccus-like morphology. They share the explicit method but have no assigned numeric size or catalytic result and were excluded from the photocatalysis study.

source_interpretation.title: Catalytic outcome belongs to an additionally dried specimen
source_interpretation.text: Catalysts were rotary-evaporated 45°C then dried 110°C 1 h. The assay uses 10 mg/L phenol, 1 g/L TiO2, 75 mL in an 80 mL tube, dark 30 min, 365 nm 16 W UV with stirring. Table 1 contains 6 h efficiencies. The no-catalyst blank and catechol explanation stay qualitative; curves were not digitized.
source_interpretation.source_locator: Main pp. 2–5, Section 2.4, Section 3.3, Figure 5 and Table 1

source_interpretation.title: Growth mechanism remains an attributed interpretation
source_interpretation.text: Equation 2 proposes peroxotitanate condensation and growth units; Scheme 1 attributes anisotropy to solvent/facet interactions. The scheme expressly does not depict real crystal lengths. Literature pH 3–9, methanol and 2-propanol discussions are explanatory context, not added experimental conditions or reagents for these recipes.

Source-attributed proposed growth sequence with final solvothermal treatment; not measured dissolved speciation or a balanced experimentally verified stoichiometric reaction.

source_conflicts: Main p.3 lists Scherrer sizes 13.4, 11.0, 10.2, 8.9 and 11.8 nm after discussing Figure2 e–i, whose caption orders ethanol through water. Table1 instead explicitly labels these values TW, TWE4, TWE1, TWE0.25 and TE. Numeric sample assignments here follow the explicit Table1 row labels; the conflicting prose order is retained, not silently resolved.
Main pp.3 and5 describe the mixed-solvent TEM range as47.0 to9.0nm, while Table1 explicitly reports9.7nm for TWE0.25. The labeled table value remains9.7nm; no replacement by9.0nm.
Table1 calls DTEM a diameter even for rodlike TW and rectangular TE. Their separate approximate length/width descriptions are preserved and are not substituted for the table metric.

Main p.3 assigns the TW HRTEM spacings3.4 and4.8Å to(101) and(002), respectively; Figure4a visibly labels0.34nm and an(001) growth arrow. These source labels are retained without crystallographic correction or invented atomic coordinates.
Main p.5 describes [001] growth as approximately2.7 times[101] but prints G100≈2.7G101. Both notations are retained as source interpretation, not a measured growth-rate result.
Table1 and p.4 print the calculated-area expression S=6/d*ρ. The literal expression and author-derived status are preserved; no density value, operator correction or recomputation is introduced.
limitations: Complete supplied six-page main read textually and visually; no distinct identity-matched local SI found in the targeted existing folders. Cited full texts unreviewed. Independent scientific comparison passed; presentation pending.
Water volume used to make0.2M Ti(SO4)2,3M ammonia dose and preparation from25% commercial stock, and washing volumes are unknown. No inferred solution volume or moles are substituted.
Aging temperature, ultrasound power, stirring rates, H2O2 addition rate, reflux atmosphere, heating/cooling ramps and pressure are unreported. Ice–water bath is not assigned0°C.
The source says a Teflon autoclave lined with Teflon and70% fill; its capacity is unknown. The125mL solvent charge is not treated as a complete batch volume or converted to vessel capacity.
Sample-specific solvent ratios are volume ratios; selected-solvent total125mL is given but separately dispensed component volumes are not stated.

Pure n-propanol and n-butanol controls are poorly crystalline/aggregated with amorphous floccus-like material; no successful fully crystalline anatase claim or numeric particle size is borrowed from the five water/ethanol products.
Powder characterization and photocatalysis use prepared powders; the colloid is not silently equated to the110°C-dried catalyst. Exact physical batch identifiers are unreported.

Table1 SXRD is author-calculated area; SBET is nitrogen-adsorption area. TEM particle size and XRD crystallite size remain distinct. No unit cell refinement, measured coordinates, phase fraction or measured CIF is supplied.
Figures and Scheme1 retain explicit panel/sample scopes; Scheme1 lengths are not actual crystal dimensions. Source permission remains unverified and complete presentation pending.
